2. **Generation-Time Sampler Candidate Recording & Transport**:
   - Added [`RolloutTopLogprobs`](file:///app/miles/miles/utils/top_logprobs.py#L9-L143) (CSR storage of `(ids, log_probs, offsets)`) and [`Sample.rollout_top_logprobs`](file:///app/miles/miles/utils/types.py#L91) with validation, token-stripping, retry reset, multi-turn tool-response padding ([`update_sample_with_tool_responses`](file:///app/miles/miles/rollout/generate_utils/tool_call_utils.py#L60-L71)), and turn merging ([`_merge_sample_pair`](file:///app/miles/miles/rollout/generate_utils/sample_utils.py#L39-L185)).
   - **Unbounded sampling** (`top_p=1.0, top_k=-1`, e.g., `sql_agent_native.sh`): requests `top_logprobs_num` on `/generate` ([`compute_request_payload`](file:///app/miles/miles/rollout/generate_utils/generate_endpoint_utils.py#L54-L90), [`generate`](file:///app/miles/miles/rollout/sglang_rollout.py#L150-L263)) or `top_logprobs` on `/v1/chat/completions`, recording `meta_info["output_top_logprobs"]` via [`append_top_logprobs_metadata`](file:///app/miles/miles/rollout/generate_utils/top_logprobs.py#L22-L73).
   - **Bounded sampling-support replay** (`top_p < 1` or `top_k > 0`, e.g., `sql_agent_session.sh`): requests `sampling_logprobs_mode="support"` alongside `return_sampling_mask=True` ([`prepare_chat_request`](file:///app/miles/miles/rollout/session/request_args.py#L52-L120), [`SessionServerConfig`](file:///app/miles/miles/rollout/session/config.py#L6-L63)) and extracts both the sampled token's support-normalized log-prob and the top-$k$ support-normalized candidates in [`append_sampling_metadata`](file:///app/miles/miles/rollout/generate_utils/sampling_mask.py#L93-L146).
   - Extended the session safetensors wire ([codec.py](file:///app/miles/miles/rollout/session/samples/codec.py), [core.py](file:///app/miles/miles/rollout/session/core.py), [v2/core.py](file:///app/miles/miles/rollout/session/v2/core.py), [openai_endpoint_utils.py](file:///app/miles/miles/rollout/generate_utils/openai_endpoint_utils.py), [merge.py](file:///app/miles/miles/rollout/session/samples/merge.py)) and trainer IPC/DP conversion ([train_data_conversion.py](file:///app/miles/miles/ray/rollout/train_data_conversion.py), [log_utils.py](file:///app/miles/miles/backends/training_utils/metrics/log_utils.py), [top_logprobs.py](file:///app/miles/miles/backends/training_utils/data/top_logprobs.py)).

3. **Chunked Vocab-Parallel Score Centering Loss**:
   - Implemented [`score_centering_loss_function`](file:///app/miles/miles/backends/training_utils/loss/hub/score_centering.py#L430-L579) and [`_VocabParallelScoreCenteringLogProbs`](file:///app/miles/miles/backends/training_utils/loss/hub/score_centering.py#L129-L315), registered in [`get_loss_function`](file:///app/miles/miles/backends/training_utils/loss/hub/losses.py#L516-L533), with bf16 LM-head outputs and sampling-mask forwarding enabled in [`run_forward_backward_pass`](file:///app/miles/miles/backends/megatron_utils/model.py#L435-L545) (and [`TorchNativeTrainRayActor`](file:///app/miles/miles/backends/training_utils/torch_native/actor.py#L240-L246)).
   - Computes $\log p_y$, head probabilities $p_v$, tail ratio $\rho$ (both tail masses floored at $10^{-6}$), and IS weights (`none`, `tis`, `mis`) in chunks of `--log-probs-chunk-size` across TP shards and CP slices, saving only $O(R \cdot k)$ tensors so backward recomputes local softmax probabilities per chunk without storing full-vocabulary fp32 activations.

### Verification

- **Unit & distributed parity tests**: [test_score_centering.py](file:///app/miles/tests/fast/backends/training_utils/loss/test_score_centering.py) and [test_top_logprobs.py](file:///app/miles/tests/fast/rollout/generate_utils/test_top_logprobs.py) verify exact loss/gradient parity against the paper reference, on-policy no-op / off-policy zero-drift identities, replay of `/app/dumps/*.json.gz`, and TP1 / TP2 / CP2 / TP2xCP2 parity.

  - Replayed recorded rollouts of both recipes at `LAYOUT=tp2` and `LAYOUT=cp2` (matching TP1 step-0 loss and metrics), as well as `--score-centering-is none`.
- **Peak GPU memory (8192-token micro-batch at TP1, `log_probs_chunk_size=2048`)**:

  - Bounded (`top_k=64`): `score_centering` peaked at **31.68 GiB** allocated (**35.00 GiB** reserved) vs **34.81 GiB** allocated (**40.14 GiB** reserved) for `policy_loss` (**-3.13 GiB** allocated).
